name: Determine the boiling point of an organic compound
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: Manual of Microscale Chemistry Laboratory Kit, Chapter Characterisation and Purification, Experiment 1.1; exact PDF pages to verify during citation pass
educational_goal: Perform the Class 12 microscale chemistry experiment 'Determine the boiling point of an organic compound' and record its manual-defined observations and result.
materials: sample, capillary tube, ignition tube, thermometer, beaker, burner, stand
safety_notes: Follow the supplied manual and teacher supervision for quantities, heating, acids, bases, organic solvents, and waste disposal.
Wear eye protection and do not taste or directly handle chemicals.
